versions.localizedDescription: Are you a true gold miner? Join Business Empire in Idle Miner Tycoon, the leading business simulation trusted by millions. In this simulator, you take control as a top tycoon to build your mining empire. Unlike other tycoon games, this simulation game offers deep strategy. You can start your journey in this idle game even in offline games mode. Start as an idle miner and become an idle hero in this adventure - even as a clever goblin miner chasing hidden riches. This mine simulator is for anyone who wants to enjoy fun tycoon games. Build your business and dominate as a tycoon in our simulator games.
